sources.title: Aggie AI: Artificial Intelligence at UC Davis
sources.snippet: Aggie AI is UC Davis' growing ecosystem of artificial intelligence (AI) tools and services, designed especially for our students, faculty, and staff. An AI service hub in the making, Aggie AI empowers students, faculty, and staff to explore, learn, use, and even develop AI tools that will have a lasting impact.

sources.title: VIALab @ UC Davis
sources.snippet: VIALab at UC Davis builds visualization and human-AI teaming systems for visual analytics, machine learning, LLM interfaces, healthcare, climate, and data-driven decision making.

sources.title: Laboratory for AI, - LARA
sources.snippet: The Laboratory for AI, Robotics, and Automation (LARA) at UC Davis is at the forefront of research in artificial intelligence and robotics, focusing on the development of autonomous systems that can learn, adapt, and operate in complex environments.
